title: Should Investors Buy Costco Stock Instead of Walmart Stock? | COST Stock Analysis | WMT Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Head-to-head of the two retail giants. Revenue: Walmart $736B TTM vs Costco $294B, but Costco does nearly half the revenue with under 1/10th the store count (<1,000 vs >10,000 locations) -- an expansion runway. Margins: Walmart 4.4% vs Costco 3.82% operating; both thin for the industry. Key metric for him is inventory turnover: Costco world-class at 15.1 vs Walmart 12. E-commerce: Walmart leads (using stores to fulfill faster than Amazon, gaining share against AMZN); Costco's e-commerce grows at ~2x its overall revenue rate but from a smaller base. Valuation: both rich -- Costco 36.3x forward PE, Walmart 34x; his DCF fair values are $843 for Costco (~$900 market, fairly valued) and $70 for Walmart (~$110 market, ~36% overvalued). Verdict: Costco is the comparative pick (BUY, more fairly valued, expansion + e-commerce as premium re-igniters; bull: margin-mix improvement; bear: still rich at 36x); Walmart is an AVOID (bull: marketplace/ads could structurally lift margins; bear: multiple compression on any growth wobble). Consistent with his prior calls (COST BUY, WMT AVOID).
